name: forgelens
description: Safe editor-native coding assistant powered by local TrueForge

forgelens.askQuestions.description: Allow Run agent and Edit Selection to ask clarifying questions. Turn off to let the agent use the request and workspace conventions. Edit and test approvals still appear.

forgelens.draftModelIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum seconds from a Draft tool request to its result. Review opens immediately and counts toward the interval. For a model with a one-minute input quota, try 70 seconds. Set the local TrueForge MCP request timeout longer than this interval and any extended reviews.

forgelens.sequentialDraft.description: In Draft from context, ask the model to plan the files, then propose one file at a time with live hunk review. Requested tests run on the assembled candidate.

forgelens.compactRequests.description: Include locally selected source excerpts in the first model request and allow related files and tests in one tool call. Every change still goes through review.

forgelens.liveReview.description: Pause each proposal for hunk decisions and send the result back to the running agent.

forgelens.tokenBudget.description: Maximum o200k_base tokens in source excerpts per retrieval. Other model inputs and provider tokenization are separate.

forgelens.contextScout.description: Allow the agent to delegate discovery to a read-only native TrueForge child during a multi-file task. This uses additional model calls.

forgelens.candidateTestFixtures.description: User settings only. Map non-secret .env test fixture paths under test/ or tests/ to their exact committed Git blob IDs for approved candidate tests. The working-tree files stay excluded.

forgelens.pythonPath.description: Python executable used by Verify Saved Changes for the Flask CLI test suite.

forgelens.fallbackModel.description: Optional second model configured in TrueForge

forgelens.preloadTools.description: Preload editor tool schemas for local models that struggle with deferred tool discovery. Default keeps deferred loading.

forgelens.reasoningEffort.description: Optional provider-supported reasoning effort. Empty uses provider default; none can reduce local CPU latency.

forgelens.runTimeoutMinutes.description: Per-run deadline in minutes. On expiry, stop without automatic replay; staged edits still require review.

forgelens.modelCallTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a single model generation through TrueForge. Confirmed timeout may use the configured fallback before any edit is staged.

scripts.package: npm run check && npm run compile && npm run notices && vsce package --allow-missing-repository
